# criblio_projects (Data Source)

Returns all matching objects in `items`, following API pagination automatically. Scope the request using the required attributes below. An empty collection returns an empty list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "criblio_projects" "example" {
  group_id = "default"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Worker group ID.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `consumers` (Attributes Map) Map of Subscription consumer configurations keyed by Subscription ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--consumers))
- `description` (String) Brief description of the Project.
- `destinations` (List of String) List of Destination IDs associated with the Project.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier.
- `subscriptions` (List of String) List of Subscription IDs associated with the Project.

<a id="nestedatt--items--consumers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.consumers`

Read-Only:

- `connections` (Attributes List) Array of connections that route data from the consumer through a Pipeline or Pack to a Destination. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--consumers--connections))
- `disabled` (Boolean) It should be removed as a consumer is present or absent.
- `type` (String) Type of the Subscription consumer.

<a id="nestedatt--items--consumers--connections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.consumers.connections`

Read-Only:

- `output` (String) The <code>id</code> of the Destination to send data to.
- `pipeline` (String) The <code>id</code> of the Pipeline or Pack used to process data before it is sent to the Destination.
